paragraphs: He is mentioned in Gittin 50a, in the form: “But did not R' Elazar Nayota’ah teach…”[^1][^2]

notes.text: Nayota’ah follows the vocalized form נָיוֹתָאָה in the William Davidson digital text of Gittin 50a. That witness names Rabbi Eliezer, whereas the supplied notice and heading have Elazar. The heading’s Yuchasin alternatives Nuza’ah and Shifa’ah are retained.

The saved Davidson Gittin50a scalar has Rabbi Eliezer Nayota’ah, whereas Hyman has Elazar. The differing given name prevents transferring full Rabbi to the source occurrences, retained as R'. Nayota’ah follows the witness vocalization of ניותאה rather than the older Nivta’ah. Nuza’ah or Shifa’ah remain Hyman’s report of Yuchasin readings, without independent apparatus verification. The digital response is not inspected Vilna print or correction history.
